question.:question/problem:
Find the entry ${b}_{12}$ of the matrix $B$, where 

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The entry ${b}_{12}$ lies at the intersection of the $1$st row and $2$nd column. Therefore, ${b}_{12}=-1.$

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}
$$
